description: Parks not yet in OpenStreetMap. scripts/build-skateparks.mjs merges these into data/skateparks-on.json after the OSM build so the weekly refresh does not drop them. If OSM later maps a park within 150 m, the OSM copy is kept and the manual entry is skipped.

parks.source: Google Maps place pin from Logan Dunning's review (43.753262, -79.4358294), 4169 Bathurst St / Lansing, North York.

Google Maps place pin from Logan Dunning's review (43.5868607, -79.6516722), 410 Rathburn Rd W, Mississauga. This is not the Guelph park of a similar memory; the review, video title and city listing all place it in Mississauga.

225 Dougall Ave, Caledon, at Southfields Community Centre. Skatepark-specific coordinates 43.756629, -79.827108 (the community centre itself is about 20 m southeast at 43.75644, -79.82696). Town of Caledon placed the park in the greenspace adjacent to Dougall Ave.
